title: Slovakian Pork Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian dish featuring pork, thai chilli jam, and shio-cure, all in a keto-friendly recipe, cooked to perfection in a kadhai vessel. This old style oven roasted casserole is a twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the thai chilli jam and shio-cure.
Season the pork shoulder with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Heat a kadhai vessel over medium-high heat and sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced onion to the kadhai and cook until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the kadhai and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sour cream and yeast to the kadhai and stir to combine.
Add the thai chilli jam and shio-cure mixture to the kadhai and stir to combine.
Cover the kadhai with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the casserole in the oven for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the sauce is bubbly.
